changes.name: MeteorPickaxeVisuals
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")

local function buildPickaxe(tool)
 for _,v in ipairs(tool:GetChildren()) do
  if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name~="Handle" then v:Destroy() end
 end
 local handle=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
 if not handle then return end
 handle.Size=Vector3.new(.38,4.6,.38)
 handle.Color=Color3.fromRGB(104,68,40)
 handle.Material=Enum.Material.Wood
 handle.CanCollide=false
 handle.Massless=true

 local function piece(name,size,cf,color,material)
  local p=Instance.new("Part")
  p.Name=name;p.Size=size;p.CFrame=handle.CFrame*cf;p.Color=color;p.Material=material
  p.CanCollide=false;p.Massless=true;p.Parent=tool
  local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");w.Part0=handle;w.Part1=p;w.Parent=p
  return p
 end

 local metal=Color3.fromRGB(32,43,78)
 local collar=piece("MetalCollar",Vector3.new(.7,.75,.7),CFrame.new(0,2.05,0),metal,Enum.Material.Metal)
 local head=piece("PickHead",Vector3.new(4.5,.42,.48),CFrame.new(0,2.38,0),metal,Enum.Material.Metal)

 -- Angled pointed ends give the head the long curved-pick silhouette.
 local left=piece("LeftPoint",Vector3.new(2.2,.28,.34),CFrame.new(-2.05,2.58,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-14)),metal,Enum.Material.Metal)
 local right=piece("RightPoint",Vector3.new(2.2,.28,.34),CFrame.new(2.05,2.58,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(14)),metal,Enum.Material.Metal)
 local ltip=piece("LeftTip",Vector3.new(1.25,.18,.25),CFrame.new(-3.55,2.92,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-25)),metal,Enum.Material.Metal)
 local rtip=piece("RightTip",Vector3.new(1.25,.18,.25),CFrame.new(3.55,2.92,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(25)),metal,Enum.Material.Metal)
end

local function hook(container)
 local function check(v)
  if v:IsA("Tool") and v.Name=="MeteorPickaxe" then task.wait();buildPickaxe(v) end
 end
 for _,v in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do check(v) end
 container.ChildAdded:Connect(check)
end

local function playerAdded(p)
 hook(p:WaitForChild("Backpack"))
 p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) hook(c) end)
 if p.Character then hook(p.Character) end
end
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(playerAdded,p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(playerAdded)

print("Classic curved meteor pickaxe visuals loaded")
